messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we received the pen test intake (PDF) for the upcoming external assessment. They flagged 6 medium / 2 high findings, but the retest requests focus on RBAC/KMS/audit gaps. Need to lock a retest window and confirm what evidence we can hand off.
jonathan: Thanks. Can we do a dry-run this Thursday? I want to validate ephemeral role provisioning and KMS proxy before handing creds to assessors.
kevin: Thursday works for infra. What exact RBAC changes do we need? Prefer to script them as ephemeral roles rather than permanent perms.
sara: For evidence packaging: prefer presigned S3 links with 7-day expiry, plus a README with log query hashes. Assessors will ask for KMS-encrypted exports.
maria: Agreed on ephemeral. Assessor asked for ability to decrypt a limited set of artifacts (test-logs/*) for 48 hours. We should not give them full KMS decrypt on prod keys.
jonathan: Proposal: create a scoped key alias kms:arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111:key/assessor-scope and grant kms:Decrypt only for a temporary IAM role. Role lifetime = 72h max, session policy scoped to prefixes.
kevin: Implementation notes:
```
# short terraform snippet (conceptual)
resource "aws_iam_role" "assessor_temp" {
  name = "assessor-temp-${timestamp}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
}
resource "aws_kms_grant" "assessor" {
  grantee_principal = aws_iam_role.assessor_temp.arn
  operations = ["Decrypt"]
  constraints = { "EncryptionContextSubset" = { "purpose" = "assessor-review" } }
}
```
We'll also rotate the grant after the window.
sec-bot: Policy scan reminder — creating KMS grants requires an approval tag `pt:grant=true` on the change request. Please file in #incidents if scope expands.
maria: Noted. Who will own the ticket to track remediation -> evidence -> retest? We need a single source of truth.
jonathan: I'll own the ticket. I'll add the checklist: RBAC change PR, KMS grant applied, audit-export produced, presigned links shared, assessor handoff note, retest slot reserved.
sara: For audit exports: we should ship both CloudTrail and app audit logs. CloudTrail: run `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time X --end-time Y` and provide gzipped JSON. Also include correlation IDs for each finding.
kevin: On retention: export window = 30 days of logs around the exploit timestamps. We should ensure our SIEM retains raw events; if not, take snapshots.
oncall-ops: Locking retest slot — reserving Fri 09:00-12:00 PT as primary, Mon 14:00-17:00 PT as fallback. I'll post calendar invites after the ticket is up.
maria: For evidence confidentiality, we'll require assessor to sign the updated NDA addendum (email from legal). Can SecOps confirm before we hand presigned links?
sec-bot: Legal verification workflow: attach signed PDF to ticket, sec-bot will check existence and stamp `legal:ok`. No access granted without stamp.
jonathan: One more: we need to prove audit immutability for the samples. I'll attach a short script that computes SHA256 digests and include them in the evidence README. Example:
```
for f in *.json.gz; do sha256sum "$f" >> evidence-digests.txt; done
```
Include date + timezone in header.
sara: Sounds good. After retest we should automate a quick post-retest regression run against the same prompt set. Add that to the ticket.
maria: Great. Action items summary: jonathan -> create ticket + RBAC PR draft; kevin -> KMS grant playbook; sara -> evidence export + digests; oncall-ops -> calendar invites; sec-bot/legal -> NDA stamp. Everyone confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:
jonathan: Confirmed. I'll start the PR and tag reviewers.
kevin: Confirmed, I'll prep the grant runbook and dry-run it with infra.
sara: Confirmed, will package artifacts and write the README.
oncall-ops: Confirmed, will post invites after PR is created.
sec-bot: Automated check will run on PR creation. Remember to include `pt:grant=true` tag.
maria: Thanks all — I'll close the loop once ticket 12345 exists.
